question: Which of the following words is not related to the cricket game? (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 2)

question: Which year is the Olympic flag flagged for the first time? (RPF Constable 2018 (24/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: 1896
1942
1920
1900
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1920

Explanation:
The Olympic flag was first flown in 1920 at the Antwerp Olympics (Belgium). The flag was designed by Pierre de Coubertin in 1913. It features five interlocking rings representing the five continents (Africa, America, Asia, Europe, Oceania). The colors of the rings (blue, yellow, black, green, red) along with the white background include at least one color from every national flag worldwide. It was first presented at the 1914 Olympic Congress but due to World War I, its use was delayed until 1920. The flag was officially hoisted at the 1920 Games, becoming a symbol of the Olympic movement.
